verdict.rationale: The project-local half is well documented: the `npx skills` installer writes editable skill files into your repo as ordinary files you own (docs-2, docs-24, docs-47, docs-48). The alternative is a managed, read-only plugin bundle installed through the Claude Code, Codex or Copilot plugin commands (docs-1, docs-10, gh-9, gh-10, gh-11). That choice is framed as subscribe-vs-fork rather than an explicit project-vs-user-global scope option, so global availability is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit user-global install scope option, documentation that the plugin route applies across all projects, and confirmation that local files are meant to be committed with the repo.
